Create a PNU analysis specification

Source: R/RunAnalyses.R
createPnuAnalysisArgs.Rd

Bundles all step-specific settings for one run of the PNU pipeline. Pass a list of these objects to [runPnuAnalyses()].

Usage

createPnuAnalysisArgs(
  analysisId = 1L,
  description = "",
  pnuCohortArgs = NULL,
  studyPopulationArgs,
  tcpsArgs = NULL,
  matchingArgs,
  outcomeModelArgs,
  bootstrapArgs = NULL,
  balanceArgs = NULL
)

Arguments

analysisId

(`integer(1)`) Unique analysis identifier. Default: `1`.

description

(`character(1)`) Human-readable label. Default: `""`.

pnuCohortArgs

A [PnuCohortArgs] object specifying cohort IDs. Required when [runPnuAnalyses()] loads data from a database; optional (pass `NULL`) when `pnuDataList` is supplied.

studyPopulationArgs

A [StudyPopulationArgs] object.

tcpsArgs

A [TcpsArgs] object. Pass `NULL` (default) to skip TCPS fitting and assign propensity score `0.5` uniformly — useful for testing set-0 equivalence with CohortMethod.

matchingArgs

A [MatchingArgs] object.

outcomeModelArgs

An [OutcomeModelArgs] object.

bootstrapArgs

A [BootstrapArgs] object, or `NULL` (default) to skip bootstrapping and use Wald-type CIs from the outcome model.

balanceArgs

A [BalanceArgs] object, or `NULL` (default) to skip covariate balance computation.

Value

A `PnuAnalysis` R6 object.

See also

[runPnuAnalyses()]

Examples

analysis <- createPnuAnalysisArgs(
  analysisId          = 1L,
  description         = "Primary analysis",
  studyPopulationArgs = createStudyPopulationArgs(outcomeId = 1L),
  matchingArgs        = createMatchingArgs(),
  outcomeModelArgs    = createOutcomeModelArgs()
)
